Operating Characteristics of the Waterfall Drug-Combination Design

Source: R/sim_waterfall.R
sim_waterfall.Rd

Simulate a trial of two drugs given together, run with the waterfall design of Zhang and Yuan (2016), many times under one matrix of true DLT probabilities, and summarize how often each dose combination is selected as an MTD of the contour, how often the whole contour is selected, how many patients are treated at each combination and how many DLTs are observed.

Usage

sim_waterfall(
  target,
  p_true,
  cohort_size,
  n_cohort = NULL,
  n_trials = 10000,
  n_earlystop = 12,
  p_saf = NULL,
  p_tox = NULL,
  cutoff_eli = 0.95,
  extrasafe = FALSE,
  offset = 0.05,
  titration = FALSE,
  bound_mtd = FALSE,
  boin_compatible = FALSE,
  keep_trials = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  seed = 123
)

Arguments

target

Numeric scalar. Target DLT probability, for example 0.30.

p_true

Numeric matrix. True DLT probability of each dose combination, with one row per dose level of drug A and one column per dose level of drug B, both in increasing dose order. It needs at least two rows and no more rows than columns.

cohort_size

Integer scalar. Number of patients per cohort.

n_cohort

Integer vector with one element per dose level of drug A, or NULL. Maximum number of cohorts of the first, second, ... subtrial. Defaults to NULL, which gives every subtrial about four patients per dose of the subtrial (see Details).

n_trials

Integer scalar. Number of trials to simulate. Defaults to 10000.

n_earlystop

Integer scalar. A subtrial ends once this many patients have been treated at the dose chosen for its next cohort. Defaults to 12.

p_saf

Numeric scalar. Highest DLT probability deemed subtherapeutic. Defaults to 0.6 * target.

p_tox

Numeric scalar. Lowest DLT probability deemed overly toxic. Defaults to 1.4 * target.

cutoff_eli

Numeric scalar. Posterior probability cutoff for eliminating a combination. Defaults to 0.95.

extrasafe

Logical scalar. Apply the stricter safety stopping rule at the lowest dose of every subtrial. Defaults to FALSE.

offset

Numeric scalar between 0 and 0.5. Amount by which cutoff_eli is relaxed for the safety stopping rule. Defaults to 0.05.

titration

Logical scalar. Start the first subtrial with one patient per dose, up to the first DLT. Ignored when cohort_size is one. Defaults to FALSE.

bound_mtd

Logical scalar. Require the estimate at the candidate MTD of a subtrial to be below the de-escalation boundary. Defaults to FALSE.

boin_compatible

Logical scalar. Drop the data of a subtrial that ends without a candidate MTD, as BOIN::get.oc.comb() does (see Details). Defaults to FALSE.

keep_trials

Logical scalar. Keep the full trial by trial data in the result. Defaults to FALSE.

verbose

Logical scalar. Report progress while the simulation runs. Defaults to FALSE.

seed

Integer scalar or NULL. Random seed. The state of the calling session is restored on exit. Defaults to 123.

Value

An object of class waterfall_oc, which is a list with components

sel_percent

Matrix of the percentage of trials selecting each combination as the MTD of its level of drug A. A trial can select one combination per level of drug A, so the percentages can add up to more than 100.

percent_no_mtd

Percentage of trials selecting no MTD at any level of drug A.

n_pts_dose

Matrix of the average number of patients treated at each combination.

n_tox_dose

Matrix of the average number of DLTs observed at each combination.

total_n_pts

Average total number of patients per trial.

total_n_tox

Average total number of DLTs per trial.

total_n_enrolled

Average number of patients treated per trial, including those of subtrials whose data were dropped; it differs from total_n_pts only with boin_compatible = TRUE.

true_mtd

Two-column matrix of the dose levels of drug A and drug B of the true MTD contour.

pct_contour_selected

Percentage of trials selecting exactly the true MTD contour; NA when no level of drug A has a true MTD.

pct_patients_contour

Percentage of all patients treated on the true MTD contour.

pct_patients_above

Percentage of all patients treated above it.

pct_patients_below

Percentage of all patients treated below it.

avg_n_subtrials

Average number of subtrials per trial.

stop_reason_percent

Percentage of trials by reason for ending.

trials

Trial level data when keep_trials is TRUE, otherwise NULL; mtd is a matrix with one row per trial and one column per level of drug A, holding the level of drug B of the MTD.

together with the design parameters and the call.

Details

The trials are simulated with waterfall_simulate and the MTD contour is selected with waterfall_select_mtd; the rules, and the points in which they differ from the article and from the reference implementation, are described there. With boin_compatible = TRUE, the same seed and matching arguments, the results equal those of BOIN::get.oc.comb() with mtd.contour = TRUE; with a seed of 6, 1000 trials and the default n_cohort, they are the results of the article.

The true MTD of a level of drug A is the combination of that row whose DLT probability is closest to target, provided it does not exceed target + 0.05. A combination is below the contour when both of its dose levels are at most those of some true MTD, and above it when both are at least those of some true MTD; every other combination, including the true MTDs, counts as on the contour. These are the definitions of the reference implementation. The three percentages of patients are NA when no level of drug A has a true MTD.

The phase I/II extension of the article is not provided.

References

Zhang, L. and Yuan, Y. (2016). A Practical Bayesian Design to Identify the Maximum Tolerated Dose Contour for Drug Combination Trials. Statistics in Medicine, 35(27), 4924-4936.

Yan, F., Zhang, L., Zhou, Y., Pan, H., Liu, S. and Yuan, Y. (2020). BOIN: An R Package for Designing Single-Agent and Drug-Combination Dose-Finding Trials Using Bayesian Optimal Interval Designs. Journal of Statistical Software, 94(13), 1-32.

See also

sim_waterfall_multi, waterfall_simulate, waterfall_select_mtd, sim_comb_boin

Examples

# Scenario 1 of Zhang and Yuan (2016): the MTD contour is A1B3 and A2B2
p_true <- matrix(c(0.03, 0.10, 0.28,
                   0.10, 0.30, 0.50), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)

oc <- sim_waterfall(
  target = 0.30,
  p_true = p_true,
  cohort_size = 3,
  n_trials = 500,
  seed = 123
)
oc
#> Waterfall drug-combination operating characteristics
#>   target DLT rate : 0.3
#>   dose levels     : 2 of drug A, 3 of drug B
#>   trials          : 500
#>   cohorts         : at most 6/3 per subtrial, of size 3
#>   max sample size : 27
#>   lambda_e / _d   : 0.2365 / 0.3585
#> 
#>               Item Drug A   B1   B2   B3
#>  True DLT rate (%)     A1  3.0 10.0 28.0
#>                        A2 10.0 30.0 50.0
#>   MTD selected (%)     A1  0.0 16.2 83.8
#>                        A2 23.8 58.2 17.6
#>   Patients treated     A1  3.4  1.9  7.1
#>                        A2  5.4  6.6  2.5
#>  Patients with DLT     A1  0.1  0.2  2.0
#>                        A2  0.5  2.0  1.3
#> 
#> No MTD selected at any level of drug A : 0%
#> Average number of patients             : 26.9
#> Average number of DLTs                 : 6.1
#> Average number of subtrials            : 2
#> 
#> True MTD contour                       : A1B3, A2B2
#>   Trials selecting exactly the contour : 48.6%
#>   Patients treated on the contour      : 51%
#>   Patients treated above the contour   : 9.3%
#>   Patients treated below the contour   : 39.7%

# \donttest{
# The settings of the article
oc_article <- sim_waterfall(
  target = 0.30,
  p_true = p_true,
  cohort_size = 3,
  n_trials = 1000,
  boin_compatible = TRUE,
  seed = 6
)
oc_article$sel_percent
#>      B1   B2   B3
#> A1  0.3 15.5 84.2
#> A2 21.1 59.8 18.5
# }
